Card Q&A.a: You can, but you won't be able to place any cards at the bottom of your security stack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card if I don't have a [Patamon] in play?

Effect: [Main] If you have [T.K. Takaishi] in play, place 1 of your [Patamon] at the bottom of your security stack face down. Trash that Digimon's digivolution cards.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to your hand.
